_provenance.derivedFrom: Transport for London open data (NaPTAN / TfL fare zones), aggregated by doogal.co.uk
_provenance.licence: TfL open data — Powered by TfL Open Data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights.
_provenance.method: Fare zones are station-based. Each stations Zone column is TfLs published zone; multi-zone stations (e.g. "3,4,5,6") are recorded as their LOWER zone. Rows with a blank zone were dropped.
_provenance.note: Venues are assigned the zone of their NEAREST station by great-circle distance — a documented approximation, not an official area polygon.
